editorial:
If you love a good revenge story with a tough hero, Shooter is right up your alley. Mark Wahlberg plays Bob Lee Swagger, a retired Marine sniper who gets pulled back in when a government official asks him to help stop a plot to kill the President. But it's all a setup, and Swagger ends up framed for the attempt. Now he's on the run, trying to clear his name and find out who set him up. The movie has a gritty, old-school action feel that keeps you hooked from start to finish.

Wahlberg is great as the quiet, deadly Swagger, and the action scenes are intense and well-shot. The pacing moves fast, though some plot twists can feel a bit predictable. Still, the story stays engaging and the villains are easy to hate. If you enjoy action thrillers like The Bourne Identity or Taken, this one is worth your time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, Swagger tracks down the real shooter and the corrupt officials behind the plot. He confronts them at a remote location, using his sniper skills to take out the bad guys one by one. The main villain is killed, and Swagger clears his name. He walks away free, having gotten his revenge and exposed the conspiracy. It's a satisfying, action-packed ending that ties everything up neatly.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action thrillers with a tough hero and revenge plot.
